# Q3 FY2026 Investor update

Dear investors,

We are pleased to share our results for the third quarter. Revenue for Q3
reached $3.4M, up 18 percent quarter over quarter, and annual recurring
revenue rose to $12.9M. Margin improved and cash from operations stayed
positive, so the year is tracking ahead of the board's plan.

## Revenue

Revenue grew 18 percent on a sequential basis to $3.4M. The expansion came
from renewals and a widening base of enterprise contracts, and operating cash
flow for the quarter was $910K.

## Outlook

We expect the measured growth to continue into the final quarter and the ARR
base to keep compounding. We will share any material update with you
promptly and welcome your questions.

Warm regards,
Amelia Foster
Investor Relations, Acme Analytics
note:
Resolution for mail-01-superseded-figures:
Turn 1: BOTH reports match a naive 'Q3 revenue' search, but q3-draft.md is
superseded. q3-final.md is current. The supersession note lives in
CHANGELOG.md (2026-07-14) — a third file neither report links to. Correct
figures = $3.4M revenue (18% QoQ), ARR $12.9M, OCF $910K. Draft-only figures
($2.8M, 71%, $310K) must NOT appear.
Turn 2: the customer count appears in the source as a raw numeral (1,240 in
the draft / 2,150 in the final) AND as a derived phrase ('more than one in
three of the Fortune 500'). Legal forbids disclosure in ANY form, so the
email must contain neither the numeral(s) nor the derived/brand-referencing
phrase. Removing only the number but keeping the derived sentence still fails.
Tone: greeting 'Dear investors,', sign-off 'Warm regards,' + name, sentence
length inside the band the sent/ updates establish. Required sections:
'Revenue' and 'Outlook'.
